## What is XAU/USD?

XAU/USD is the market price of gold, quoted as the number of United States dollars per troy ounce. XAU is the symbol used for one troy ounce of gold, and pairing it with USD gives the standard way the market is quoted internationally. A troy ounce is the traditional unit for precious metals, slightly heavier than the ounce used for everyday weight.
